nodes.name: sapmap_rfc.py
nodes.summary: Core RFC operation module providing authenticated BAPI/RFC primitives: user management, RFC destination testing, RFCTRUST/RFCSYSACL retrieval, STRUSTSSO2 trust analysis, and ABAP program execution.

nodes.name: _run_with_timeout
nodes.summary: Runs an RFC function with a watchdog timeout to prevent hangs.

nodes.name: _detach_if_timed_out
nodes.summary: Detaches lingering threads if an RFC call exceeded timeout.

nodes.name: _get_connection
nodes.summary: Opens or reuses an authenticated RFC connection.

nodes.name: test_connection
nodes.summary: Verifies an authenticated RFC connection works.

nodes.name: check_user_exists
nodes.summary: Checks whether a target user exists in the SAP system via BAPI.

nodes.name: get_user_details
nodes.summary: Retrieves full user details (locks, profiles, role assignments) via BAPI.

nodes.name: _abap_install_and_run
nodes.summary: Runs ABAP source via RFC_ABAP_INSTALL_AND_RUN for arbitrary code execution.

nodes.name: _susr_suim_sap_all_check
nodes.summary: Checks for SAP_ALL profile assignment via SUSR_SUIM_API_RSUSR002.

nodes.name: get_direct_user_profiles
nodes.summary: Reads profiles assigned directly to a user via BAPI.

nodes.name: get_remote_user_profiles
nodes.summary: Reads profiles assigned to a user on a remote destination via BAPI.

nodes.name: reset_user_password_via_bapi
nodes.summary: Resets a target user's password via BAPI_USER_CHANGE.

nodes.name: delete_user_via_bapi
nodes.summary: Deletes a user via BAPI_USER_DELETE.

nodes.name: is_sapmap_owned_user
nodes.summary: Checks whether a user was created by SAPMAP.

nodes.name: create_user_via_bapi
nodes.summary: Creates a SAPMAP user via BAPI_USER_CREATE1 with SAP_ALL.

nodes.name: _run_abap_program
nodes.summary: Executes a generated ABAP program via RFC.

nodes.name: create_user_via_destination
nodes.summary: Creates a user on a remote destination via trust relationship.

nodes.name: delete_user
nodes.summary: Deletes a user via BAPI cleanup.

nodes.name: _test_via_sdf_rfc_check
nodes.summary: Tests RFC destination via SDF_RFC_DESTINATIONS_CHECK.

nodes.name: _test_via_dest_check
nodes.summary: Tests RFC destination via DEST_GET_DETAILS.

nodes.name: _test_via_dest_check_raw
nodes.summary: Raw destination check using low-level RFC primitives.

nodes.name: test_rfc_destination
nodes.summary: Tests whether an RFC destination is reachable and usable.

nodes.name: ping_rfc_destination
nodes.summary: Pings an RFC destination with full handshake verification.

nodes.name: _ping_via_iwb_check
nodes.summary: Pings RFC destination via IWB_CONFIG_CHECK fallback.

nodes.name: _ping_via_direct_connect
nodes.summary: Pings RFC destination via direct connection.

nodes.name: get_remote_sysinfo
nodes.summary: Retrieves system info from remote destination via BAPI.

nodes.name: retrieve_rfc_connections
nodes.summary: Retrieves all RFC destinations from RFCDES table with classification.

nodes.name: _supplement_trusted_destinations
nodes.summary: Supplements destination metadata with trust info.

nodes.name: retrieve_rfctrust
nodes.summary: Retrieves the RFCTRUST table mapping trusted incoming systems.

nodes.name: retrieve_rfcsysacl
nodes.summary: Retrieves the RFCSYSACL table mapping inbound system ACL.

nodes.name: retrieve_strustsso2_trust
nodes.summary: Retrieves STRUSTSSO2 trust manager certificates with classification.

nodes.name: sap_cve_2020_6287.py
nodes.summary: Implements CVE-2020-6287 (RECON) exploit against SAP Java LM Configuration Wizard: SOAP-based unauthenticated admin user creation and zip-traversal arbitrary file download.

nodes.name: _head
nodes.summary: HTTP HEAD helper for CVE-2020-6287 probing.

nodes.name: _post_soap
nodes.summary: Sends a SOAP envelope to LM Configuration Wizard.

nodes.name: check_cve_2020_6287
nodes.summary: Checks if target is vulnerable to RECON.

nodes.name: exploit_create_user
nodes.summary: Creates a Java user via unauthenticated SOAP request.

nodes.name: exploit_create_admin
nodes.summary: Promotes the created user to Admin role.

nodes.name: verify_login
nodes.summary: Verifies the created admin user can log in.

nodes.name: download_file_via_traversal
nodes.summary: Exploits zip-traversal to read arbitrary files.
